import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import lightgbm as lgb
import time

# Start timing
start_time = time.time()

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv(
    "./input/labels.csv", nrows=10000000, skiprows=lambda i: i > 0 and i % 5 != 0
)  # ~2M rows, but with better distribution
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


# Haversine distance calculation
def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth's radius in kilometers
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return R * c


# NYC region bounding boxes for clustering
nyc_regions = {
    "manhattan": ((40.700, -74.020), (40.800, -73.930)),
    "bronx": ((40.780, -73.930), (40.900, -73.750)),
    "brooklyn": ((40.570, -74.050), (40.740, -73.830)),
    "queens": ((40.530, -73.950), (40.800, -73.700)),
    "staten_island": ((40.490, -74.260), (40.650, -74.050)),
    "jfk": ((40.640, -73.790), (40.660, -73.750)),
    "lga": ((40.770, -73.880), (40.785, -73.850)),
    "outside_nyc": ((40.500, -74.260), (41.000, -73.700)),
}


def get_region(lat, lon):
    for region, ((lat_min, lon_min), (lat_max, lon_max)) in nyc_regions.items():
        if lat_min <= lat <= lat_max and lon_min <= lon <= lon_max:
            return region
    return "outside_nyc"


# Feature engineering
def add_features(df):
    df = df.copy()

    # Convert datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])

    # Time features
    df["pickup_hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["pickup_dayofweek"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["pickup_month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

    # Geospatial features
    df["pickup_region"] = df.apply(
        lambda row: get_region(row["pickup_latitude"], row["pickup_longitude"]), axis=1
    )
    df["dropoff_region"] = df.apply(
        lambda row: get_region(row["dropoff_latitude"], row["dropoff_longitude"]),
        axis=1,
    )

    return df


# Process data
print("Engineering features...")
train = add_features(train)
test = add_features(test)

# Filter extreme values
train = train[(train["fare_amount"] >= 2.5) & (train["fare_amount"] <= 200)]
train = train[(train["passenger_count"] > 0) & (train["passenger_count"] <= 6)]

# One-hot encode regions on train
region_cols = ["pickup_region", "dropoff_region"]
for col in region_cols:
    dummies = pd.get_dummies(train[col], prefix=col, dummy_na=False)
    train = pd.concat([train, dummies], axis=1)
    train.drop(col, axis=1, inplace=True)

# One-hot encode regions on test, aligning columns with train
for col in region_cols:
    dummies = pd.get_dummies(test[col], prefix=col, dummy_na=False)
    test = pd.concat([test, dummies], axis=1)
    test.drop(col, axis=1, inplace=True)

# Align test columns with train (fill missing region columns with 0 and drop extra columns)
missing_cols = set(train.columns) - set(test.columns)
for col in missing_cols:
    if col != "fare_amount":
        test[col] = 0

test = test[train.columns.drop("fare_amount")]

# Haversine distance
train["haversine_dist"] = haversine(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)
test["haversine_dist"] = haversine(
    test["pickup_latitude"],
    test["pickup_longitude"],
    test["dropoff_latitude"],
    test["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Absolute differences
train["abs_diff_lat"] = np.abs(train["dropoff_latitude"] - train["pickup_latitude"])
train["abs_diff_lon"] = np.abs(train["dropoff_longitude"] - train["pickup_longitude"])
test["abs_diff_lat"] = np.abs(test["dropoff_latitude"] - test["pickup_latitude"])
test["abs_diff_lon"] = np.abs(test["dropoff_longitude"] - test["pickup_longitude"])

# Prepare features
base_features = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "haversine_dist",
    "pickup_hour",
    "pickup_dayofweek",
    "pickup_month",
    "abs_diff_lat",
    "abs_diff_lon",
]

# Get region one-hot columns dynamically (from train, excluding fare_amount)
train_feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col != "fare_amount"]
feature_cols = base_features + [
    col
    for col in train_feature_cols
    if col.startswith(("pickup_region_", "dropoff_region_"))
]

# Split data for validation
X = train[feature_cols]
y = train["fare_amount"]
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42)

# LightGBM model with tuned hyperparameters
print("Training LightGBM model...")
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.03,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 25,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y_train, params={"verbose": -1})
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val, reference=lgb_train, params={"verbose": -1})

model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Validation RMSE
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((val_predictions - y_val) ** 2))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Predict test set
print("Generating predictions for test set...")
test_predictions = model.predict(test[feature_cols])

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test["key"], "fare_amount": test_predictions})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Final time check
print(f"Total runtime: {time.time() - start_time:.2f} seconds")
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
